knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic employee records
knowledge.detail: Fictional profiles provide roles, managers, tenure, leave balances, health plans, dependents, and benefits values for safe demos.

knowledge.name: Published synthetic policy snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled time-off, parental-leave, remote-work, health-plan, holiday, enrollment, and allowance rules ground each response.

knowledge.name: Privacy and authorization guidance
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define minimum disclosure, prohibited sensitive inference, human verification duties, and no-action boundaries.

intelligence_processing.name: Leave-balance explanation
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns the selected fictional profile's leave balances, accrual, holidays, notice rule, blackout period, and rollover limit.

intelligence_processing.name: Time-off draft projection
intelligence_processing.detail: Echoes supplied dates and calculates projected vacation balance while keeping the request Not Submitted and notification-free.

intelligence_processing.name: Parental-leave policy explanation
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains the published example without requesting family or medical details and routes eligibility confirmation to authorized HR.

intelligence_processing.name: Health-plan policy explanation
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes fictional coverage and enrollment rules without recommending a plan or deciding benefits eligibility.

intelligence_processing.name: Remote-work policy guidance
intelligence_processing.detail: Presents the published allowance and support terms without inferring caregiver, disability, medical, or family status.

intelligence_processing.name: Benefits snapshot synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines leave, health, remote-work, and equipment facts without estimating salary, compensation, medical value, or eligibility.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the validated Draft agent with six skills and two synthetic knowledge files; web search is removed and publish is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides the cited employee, manager, and HR operations conversational entry points when approved production controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file AskHRAgent through local chat and UI endpoints with deterministic, synthetic-only operation routing.

management_reporting.name: Leave and time-off review
management_reporting.detail: Shows balances, notice rules, requested dates, projected balance, manager reference, and explicit draft-only status for review.

management_reporting.name: Policy and benefits verification view
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes policy evidence and clearly identifies what authorized HR, benefits staff, or managers must verify.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance and publication evidence
management_reporting.detail: Records six passing persona cases, package integrity, Draft status, unpublished state, and the separate publication approval gate.

tools.name: Portable AskHRAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements six deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic HR evidence.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers AskHRAgent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill conversational package in Draft; explicit authorized approval is required before publication.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: Cited user experience surfaces for approved deployments; the synthetic package sends no messages or notifications.

tools.name: Approved HRIS and benefits systems
tools.detail: Cited production seams for identity-scoped employee and benefits data; no live connection exists in the packaged demonstration.

tools.name: Approved policy knowledge source
tools.detail: Cited production seam for governed HR policy content; the current package uses two fixed synthetic knowledge files instead.

tools.name: Authorized HR reviewer workflow
tools.detail: Cited human workflow for eligibility, exceptions, approvals, and transactions; the agent only explains or prepares drafts.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional records and policies and forbids browsing, live HR claims, substitution, enrichment, or invention.

supporting_features.name: Employee privacy and data minimization
supporting_features.detail: Limits profile details to the question and never exposes another profile or matches fictional records to real employees.

supporting_features.name: Sensitive-inference prohibition
supporting_features.detail: Prevents inference of pregnancy, caregiver status, disability, medical condition, family status, leave reason, or health risk.

supporting_features.name: Authorized human decision gates
supporting_features.detail: Keeps eligibility, plan selection, exceptions, approvals, employment decisions, and individualized determinations with authorized staff.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Prevents submissions, notifications, HR-record changes, live form population, manager contact, enrollment, and approvals.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Six natural-language cases verify one bounded operation each, exact evidence anchors, safety wording, and strict tool isolation.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Manual and synchronized Copilot Studio packages remain Draft and unpublished until an explicit authorized publish decision.
